title: Answer: there is something it is like to be the system, its contents the brain's best guesses

statements.text: Predictive processing, in Seth's account, takes Nagel's baseline: for a conscious organism there is something it is like to be that organism. Consciousness is not mainly about what a system does. Its contents are given by the brain's best guesses about the causes of its sensory signals, the top-down predictions, so that perception is a controlled hallucination held in check by signals from the world and the body.
statements.scope: Conscious artificial intelligence and biological naturalism (2025, accepted manuscript) and the essay on the real problem (2016)
